title: Dependency Injection
description: Implement IoC with dependency injection for loosely coupled code.

data.text: **Dependency Injection (DI)** is a design pattern that implements Inversion of Control (IoC). Dependencies are provided to a class rather than the class creating them itself.

data.title: DI in .NET
Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Use DI to create loosely coupled, testable, and maintainable applications.
